description: the box of bicubic-top-box-edge-fillet, written by tools/oracle/occt_nurbs_blend.py: the top edge on the wall y = 0, the B-spline isocurve v = 0, chamfered at d 0.5. A NURBS face against a plane has no closed form, so the chamfer is a walked stripe (ADR-0062): each contact lies in the edge's normal plane at chord d from the edge's point on its face, the surface is the ruled surface between the two contact curves fitted to the tolerance, each end cut by the wall across, x = 0 and x = 10, both planes (plans/nurbs-face-blend step 7). Open CASCADE's contact on the B-spline top misses the chord d by 2.8e-7 at the median and 2.5e-6 at the 90th percentile (5.5e-6 at most); Arris' holds it to rounding, so Open CASCADE's volume lies 1.4e-7 relative from Arris'. The measure tolerances cover that miss, under ADR-0062's 1e-5 for a walked fixture (no closed form holds the blend)
